issuer: the Missouri Department of Revenue, Motor Vehicle and Driver Licensing
note: The Department of Revenue's licence page (read 2026-10-30) gives the Class F licence, minimum age 18, at $33 for up to 6 years ($16.50 for 3), the intermediate Class F licence from 16, and the nondriver ID, no minimum age, at $24. The card's term is read from the same table's 6-year column, where its $24 sits; this is a reading of the table's layout, worth checking. Not held: the 75-and-older skills test, the free ID for voting. On 2026-10-30 the licence was rewritten with the terms set by the holder's age, from the same page's expiration table: 3 years at $16.50 from 18 to 20, 6 years at $33 from 21 to 69, and 3 years at $16.50 from 70 (each band's fee the table's 3-year or 6-year column); until then it held the 6-year licence only. The card is as it was: the table gives the nondriver ID three figures of $24 under four columns (3 years, 6 years, non-expiring, duplicate), and the non-expiring card of 70 and over isn't held for that.
